propose.title: Propose a change
propose.fieldsHint: Edit what needs to change. Leave the other details as they are.
propose.moneyHint: Enter dollars and cents. Service fees are shown below.
propose.hoursHint: The most hours included in the booking, up to 24.
propose.scopeHint: Describe the full task with the proposed changes. Use 10–2,000 characters.
propose.expensesHint: The amount set aside for agreed supplies. Enter 0 if none are needed.
propose.messageHint: Explain why you're proposing this change. Use 10–1,000 characters.
propose.quoteHint: Change at least one detail and add your message to see the money before and after.
propose.confirmDescription: The other person will review your proposal. Your current terms stay in place until the change is accepted and any payment is complete.
propose.blockedDescription: Review the open change before proposing another one.
propose.notAllowed: This booking can't change right now. Return to the booking to check for an open change.
propose.noChanges: Change at least one detail before sending your proposal.

review.currentTermsApply: The current terms stay in place until this change is applied.
review.newTermsApply: The proposed terms now apply to this booking.
review.termsUnchanged: The current booking terms stay in place.
review.paymentHint: Choose the card for the difference. The new terms apply after payment goes through.
review.paymentMissing: A payment method is needed to continue. Return to the booking and reopen this change to load your cards.
